projects.name: Tickets
projects.description: Tickets is a web application that enables users to manage their bank accounts in a secure and digital manner. The app offers features such as automated operations, analytics, AI capabilities, and the ability to import transactions by capturing images of shopping receipts, bills, and more. With thousands of users, the app continues to grow, and new features and fixes are implemented daily. For more information, visit the Tickets website.

projects.name: marcdown
projects.description: A lightweight native macOS markdown editor that lives in the background—summoned by Cmd+Shift+Space to capture ideas in plain text. Built with Swift 6 and AppKit, it stores everything locally in ~/marcdown/ with zero cloud dependencies, offering live rendering and a fully keyboard-driven workflow for distraction-free writing. Download from releases.

projects.name: commai
projects.description: An AI-powered git commit message generator that integrates seamlessly as a prepare-commit-msg hook, supporting Claude or OpenAI with just two production dependencies. It respects your existing hook chains (husky, commitlint, etc.) and fails gracefully—API errors never block your commits, letting you write the message yourself when needed. Install via npm.

projects.name: Paper
projects.description: Create and organize your ideas, work, etc., in Markdown files by category. More info.

projects.name: LucTst CLI
projects.description: A command-line interface (CLI) tool designed to streamline the creation of Node.js module projects. I developed this tool to efficiently manage the common boilerplate structures I encounter while working on numerous open-source projects. More info here

projects.name: get-readme
projects.description: A straightforward CLI tool that generates clean, well-structured README files for Node.js projects, eliminating the friction of manual boilerplate creation. Built for developers who want to spend less time on documentation setup and more time shipping code. Install via npm.

experiences.name: Linxea
experiences.description: Led a two-month technical migration for a large enterprise, transforming a tightly coupled monolith into a modern, decoupled architecture combining Strapi as a headless CMS with Next.js on the frontend. Designed content models, built REST/GraphQL APIs, and implemented optimized rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR) that cut load times, enabled independent scaling of backend and frontend services, and unblocked parallel development workflows. The result: faster performance, reduced deployment friction, and a 10x improvement in developer velocity across teams.

experiences.name: Localista

experiences.name: BIM Cloissons

experiences.name: Prestashop

experiences.name: Mentoring Openclassrooms

experiences.name: Bluecoders
